blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text prompted 3D computed tomography (CT) segmentation requires both full slice context and fine boundary precision across volumes where over $80\%$ of organ prompted slices lack the queried target. Existing medical vision language models (VLMs) are largely non native segmenters: they delegate pixel delineation outside the VLM by compressing reasoning into a 1D [SEG] vector for an external Segment Anything Model (SAM) decoder, quantizing masks into lossy discrete codebooks, or issuing box prompts to stateless external SAM tools without empty slice screening or spatial state memory. We introduce NativeSeg, a native vision language segmentation framework on Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapted Qwen3.8-27B that performs dense mask decoding, volumetric triage, spatial error self diagnosis, and multiround local zoom directly over the VLM's 2D spatial visual tokens without external SAM decoders. NativeSeg decodes confidence maps from upper layer 2D spatial tokens fused with a five slice U-Net pathway, halts at zero zooms on $>91\%$ of standalone evaluations via a native presence gate (<pres>), localizes uncertain boundaries via a 20 cell multiscale error gate (<err>), and accepts zoomed updates only when predicted error decreases. Trained solely on adult CT, NativeSeg improves Round $0$ DSC by $+19.81$ and $+7.04$ points over discrete codebook and 1D [SEG] readouts on the identical backbone, reaches $86.81\%$ adult and $87.04\%$ zero shot pediatric DSC, and safely refines 2D nnU-Net ($89.52\%$ adult; $86.86\%$ pediatric), 3D SegVol ($86.81\%$), and 3D VoxTell ($89.85\%$).
blocks.zh: 文字激发的 3D 计算成像( CT) 片断既需要完整的上下文, 也需要精细的跨卷边界精度, 其中80美元以上的器官激发的片断缺少被询问的目标 。 现有的医学视觉语言模型(VLM)基本上是非本土分解器:它们通过将推理压缩为外部分解模型(SAM)的1D[SEG]矢量,将口罩量化为丢失的离散代码簿,或者在没有空切片筛选或空间状态内存的情况下向无国籍的外部SAM工具发出框提示,将像素划分到VLM之外. 我们引入了NublicSeg(英语:NublicSeg),一个关于低阶适应(英语:Lora)的本土视觉语言分解框架(英语:Low Rank Resignation (Lora)),经过改造的Quen3.8-27B,在VLM的2D空间视觉标志上直接进行密集的口罩解码,体积分解,空间误差自我诊断,并进行多轮局部放大,没有外部SAM解码器. 土著 Seg解码来自上层的2D空间信号符的置信地图,与5个切片的U-Net路径连接,通过本土存在门(<pres>),以0 > 91美元/%的零放大值停止独立评价,通过20个单元格多尺度错误门(<err>)定位不确定边界,仅在预测错误减少时才接受缩放更新。 仅接受成人CT培训的NationalSeg将0美元DSC回合比离散的密码本增加19.81美元和7.04美元,并在相同的主干上读取1D(SEG),达到86.81美元和87.04美元;安全精炼2D nnU-Net(89.52美元成人;86.86美元儿科)、3D SegVol(86.81美元)和3D VoxTell(89.85美元)。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Accurate organ delineation in 3D computed tomography (CT) volumes underpins clinical diagnosis, surgical planning, and radiotherapy [ 15 , 41 ] .
Prompting 3D CT segmentation with natural language removes fixed label set constraints, yet exposes a fundamental tension between global anatomical context and fine local boundary resolution: recognizing organ presence and disambiguating adjacent viscera require full slice context across hundreds of axial slices, whereas tracing thin pancreatic tails, gallbladder necks, or pediatric organ walls demands high local spatial resolution [ 6 , 3 , 20 , 21 ] .
Moreover, in full volume abdominal evaluation across seven organs, 81 % 81\% to 86 % 86\% of organ prompted axial slices do not contain the queried organ [ 41 ] , making uniform high resolution VLM tokenization across every slice quadratically expensive [ 52 , 48 ] .
blocks.zh:
3D计算成型图卷的精确器官划分是临床诊断、手术规划和放射治疗[15、41]的基础。
以自然语言进行3D CT分解可以消除固定标签设定的限制,但暴露出全球解剖上下文与精细的局部边界解析度之间的根本矛盾:承认器官的存在和相邻的隔膜需要覆盖数百个轴切片的全部切片上下文,而追踪细的胰尾,胆囊颈,或儿科器官壁则需要高局部空间解析度[6,3,20,21].
此外,在7个器官的体积全腹评价中,81%的81\%至86%的器官激动轴切片没有包含被询问的器官[41],使每个器官的VLM标定值均匀高分辨率[52,48]。

blocks.en:
Although pretrained vision language models (VLMs) offer strong multimodal grounding, current VLM segmentation paradigms remain predominantly non native —treating the VLM as a symbolic router that delegates dense spatial perception and refinement to external segmentation machinery ( (a to c)).
First, single pass embedding models [ 23 , 13 , 42 , 30 ] compress an entire 2D organ shape into a single 1D [SEG] prompt vector fed into an external Segment Anything Model (SAM) mask decoder [ 22 , 31 ] , discarding the 2D spatial token topology already computed inside the VLM, while discrete codebook models [ 2 , 4 ] quantize masks onto coarse block grids.
Second, standard vision towers downsample each CT slice into a 16 × 16 16\times 16 token grid ( > 20 ​ mm >20\,\text{mm} per token in adult CT), blurring small structures when decoded in one global pass.
Third, interactive tool calling agents [ 53 , 18 , 28 , 17 ] and cascade refiners [ 3 , 32 ] hand bounding boxes or isolated crops to stateless external segmenters without native empty slice screening, global to local VLM self attention, or closed loop error verification, frequently overwriting accurate contours on clean slices.
blocks.zh:
虽然预先训练的视觉语言模型提供了强大的多式联运基础,但目前的VLM分化范式仍然主要是非本土的——将VLM作为一种象征性的路由器来对待,它将密集的空间感知和完善到外部分化机制(a至c).
首先,单传嵌入式模型[23,13,42,30]将整个2D器官形状压缩成一个单1D[SEG] 即时向量输入到外部的片段 Anything Model (SAM) 掩码器[22,31],丢弃已经计算在VLM内部的2D空间代号地形,而离散的代码簿模型[2,4]将面具量化到粗块网格.
第二,标准视塔将每个CT切片下取样成16×16 16\时的16个令牌网格( > 20mm>20\,\text{mm}每个令牌在成人CT中),在一个全局通道解码时模糊小结构.
第三,交互工具调用代理 [53, 18, 28, 17] 和级联精细器 [3, 32] 手捆箱或孤立的作物给无国籍的外部分片者,而不进行原生的空片筛选,全球到本地的VLM自我注意,或闭环错误校验,经常在干净的切片上覆盖准确的轮廓.

blocks.en:
We argue that dense perception, volumetric screening, spatial self critique, and local boundary refinement should instead be native capabilities of the VLM itself.
We propose NativeSeg ( Native Vision Language Seg mentation), a SAM free framework built on Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapted Qwen3.8-27B with a frozen vision tower ( (d, e), Fig. 2 ).
Rather than routing 1D prompts or box coordinates to external mask heads, NativeSeg operates natively over the VLM’s 2D spatial visual tokens across rounds.
In Round 0 0 , NativeSeg preserves the upper layer 16 × 16 16\times 16 spatial visual token grid and fuses it with a lightweight five slice axial U-Net decoder to predict pixelwise confidence maps directly in original slice coordinates, while a native presence token ( <pres> ) screens out target absent slices.
On candidate slices, without ground truth or external quality estimators, a native multiscale error token ( <err> ) inspects the current mask overlaid on the CT slice to predict misclassified pixel area across 1 × 1\times global, 2 × 2 2\times 2 quadrant, and 4 × 4 4\times 4 fine regions, halting immediately when predicted error is small or zooming into uncertain boundaries.
During each zoom round, high resolution local visual tokens attend natively to full slice global visual tokens inside the VLM, and candidate edits are accepted only if <err> verifies that predicted error decreases both locally and globally—supporting both standalone volumetric segmentation from scratch and plug and play refinement of external 2D or 3D specialists.
blocks.zh:
我们主张,密集的感知、体积筛选、空间自我批评、以及地方边界的完善,应该是自愿终止措施本身的本能。
我们提议在低级适应(LORA)的基础上建立一个SAM自由框架,
NationalSeg不是将1D的提示或框坐标传递到外部遮罩头,而是在VLM的2D空间视觉符号上以本土方式运行,跨回合.
在0号回合中,NationalSeg保留了上层16×16 16\时的16个空间视标格网格,并用轻量级5片轴U-Net解码器将其连接,以在原切片坐标中直接预测像素感信任图,而原生存在符符(<pres>)则屏蔽不含切片的目标.
在候选切片上,在没有地面真假或外部质量估计器的情况下,一个本土多尺度误差符号(<err>)检查CT切片上覆盖的当前遮罩,以预测全球1×1的错分类像素面积,2×2的2乘2象限,4×4的4个细区域,当预测误差小或放大到不确定的边界时,立即停止.
在每次缩放过程中,高分辨率的局部视觉符号在VLM内自发地参与全片全局视觉符号,只有当“err”验证预测错误减少时,才会接受候选编辑——从零开始支持独立的体积分解,插头和播放外部2D或3D专家的精细化。

blocks.en: Evaluated across complete 3D CT volumes without slice prefiltering on adult TotalSegmentator [ 41 ] and external zero shot Pediatric-CT-SEG [ 20 , 21 ] , this work makes three contributions: • Native 2D Spatial Token Readout without External SAM Heads. We show that preserving the VLM’s native 2D spatial visual token grid and fusing it with local five slice CT context eliminates the geometric bottleneck of 1D [SEG] prompts and discrete mask codebooks. On the identical Qwen3.8-27B backbone and adult training split, native Round 0 0 readout improves volumetric Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) by + 19.81 +19.81 and + 7.04 +7.04 points over discrete codebook and 1D [SEG] broadcast baselines ( Tab. 3 (a)). • Native Volumetric Screening and Ground Truth Free Error Localization. By embedding learnable <pres> and 20 cell multiscale <err> tokens directly into the VLM forward pass over visual mask overlays, NativeSeg screens empty slices and ranks local boundary errors natively without external critic networks, halting at zero zooms on > 91 % >91\% of full volume standalone evaluations ( 0.14 0.14 to 0.17 0.17 mean executed zooms/slice; Fig. 4 ). • Verified Native Local Zoom Across Standalone and Specialist Refiner Modes. Coupling joint global and local VLM attention with closed loop error verification and 3D axial continuity raises standalone accuracy to 86.81 % 86.81\% adult test DSC ( p = 2.3 × 10 − 7 p=2.3\times 10^{-7} ) and 87.04 % 87.04\% zero shot pediatric DSC ( p = 6.7 × 10 − 6 p=6.7\times 10^{-6} ), while safely improving 2D nnU-Net ( 89.52 % 89.52\% adult; 86.86 % 86.86\% pediatric, p = 0.024 p=0.024 ), 3D SegVol ( 86.81 % 86.81\% , p = 9.5 × 10 − 6 p=9.5\times 10^{-6} ), and 3D VoxTell ( 89.85 % 89.85\% ) where external crop refiners degrade base masks ( Tables 1 and 2 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Natural language prompting enables flexible anatomical segmentation across imaging modalities [ 27 , 49 , 10 , 14 , 51 , 26 , 34 ] .
Volumetric specialist and foundation models, including the CLIP-Driven Universal Model [ 27 ] , CAT [ 14 ] , SegVol [ 10 ] , SAT [ 51 ] , OpenVocabCT [ 26 ] , and VoxTell [ 34 ] , pair text encoders with dedicated 3D U-Net or 3D Vision Transformer (ViT) backbones, while Medal S [ 36 ] and ESICA [ 44 ] incorporate first stage 3D predictions as spatial prompts at fixed voxel resolution.
Complementarily, 2D foundation models such as BiomedParse [ 49 ] and BoltzFormer [ 50 ] process individual slices at a single global scale.
NativeSeg bridges general purpose VLMs with volumetric CT segmentation by keeping dense decoding, Round 0 0 empty slice screening, and selective local zooming native to the VLM while also serving as a plug and play refiner for 2D and 3D segmenters.
blocks.zh:
自然语言的激发可以使不同成像方式的解剖分解灵活[27、49、10、14、51、26、34]。
音量专家模型和基础模型,包括CLIP-Driven通用模型[27],CAT[14],SegVol [10],SAT[51],OpenVocabCT [26],和VoxTell [34],配有专用的3D U-Net或3D视觉变压器(ViT)主干线的对文本编码器,而奖章S[36]和ESICA[44]将第一阶段的3D预测作为空间快报纳入固定的Voxel分辨率.
作为补充,2D基础模型如BiomedParse[49]和BoltzFormer[50]在全球单一尺度上处理单个切片.
NationalSeg桥一般目的VLM,通过保持密集的解码,0轮空切片筛选,以及选择性局部放大原生到VLM,同时作为2D和3D分区器的插件和播放精炼器.

blocks.en:
Existing VLM segmentation architectures follow three designs that differ in whether spatial perception is delegated outside or kept native inside the VLM.
First, building on LISA [ 23 ] , biomedical VLMs including MedPLIB [ 13 ] , VividMed [ 30 ] , Citrus-V [ 38 ] , UniBiomed [ 42 ] , and ROSALIA [ 8 ] collapse multimodal reasoning into a 1D [SEG] token embedding and delegate pixel delineation to an external SAM mask decoder [ 22 , 31 ] .
Second, Text4Seg [ 24 ] , MedSIGHT [ 2 ] , and NTP-MRISeg [ 4 ] quantize masks into discrete codebook tokens within the large language model (LLM) vocabulary for autoregressive generation.
Third, natural image methods such as F-LMM [ 43 ] , Pixel-SAIL [ 47 ] , MLLMSeg [ 39 ] , and DenseMLLM [ 25 ] read masks natively from 2D spatial visual tokens in a single global pass, while Liu et al . [ 29 ] apply user supplied ROI crops for CT question answering.
NativeSeg eliminates both external SAM decoders and discrete block quantization, extending native 2D spatial token readout [ 43 , 25 ] beyond its coarse 16 × 16 16\times 16 global token grid through five slice axial conditioning and autonomous 2 × 2\times to 4 × 4\times local reencoding.
blocks.zh:
现有的VLM分割结构遵循三种设计,在空间感知是被下放到VLM外部还是被保留在VLM内部方面有所不同.
首先,在LISA[23]、生物医学VLM(包括MedPLIB[13])、VividMed[30]、Citrus-V[38]、UniBiomed[42]和ROSALIA[8]的基础上,将多式推理溶解为1D[SEG]符号嵌入和代表像素划分为外部SAM面具解码器[22,31]。
第二,Text4Seg [24],MedSIGHT [2],和NTP-MRISeg [4] 在大语言模型(LLM)词汇内将口罩量化为离散的代码簿符号,用于自动生成.
三,F-LMM [43],Pixel-SAIL [47],MLLMSeg [39],DenseMLM [25] 等自然影像方法在一次全局通行证中从2D空间视觉符号中原地读出口罩,而Liu et al. [29] 应用用户为CT提问回答提供了ROI作物.
NationalSeg消除了外部SAM解码器和离散区块整数,将原生的2D空间令牌读出[43,25]扩展至其粗体16×16 16\时16个全球令牌网格,通过5个切片轴调和自主2×2\时4×4×时局部重编码.

blocks.en:
Multiturn segmentation agents including SegAgent [ 53 ] , IBISAgent [ 18 ] , Ophiuchus [ 19 ] , MedSAM-Agent [ 28 ] , XFlow [ 7 ] , and nnInteractive Agent [ 16 , 17 ] iteratively emit point, scribble, or box prompts to a stateless external segmenter, or adjust parametric contours as in LLMSeg [ 11 ] .
In parallel, cascade postprocessors [ 6 , 40 , 3 , 9 ] , segmentation quality estimators [ 46 , 37 , 33 , 5 , 35 ] , and adaptive visual zoom policies [ 1 , 52 , 48 ] train separate networks for error estimation or crop editing.
Rather than handing symbolic prompts to an external crop tool without full slice VLM context or acceptance checks, NativeSeg performs error localization ( <err> ), global to local visual attention, and closed loop acceptance verification natively inside the VLM.
blocks.zh:
多回合分化剂包括SegAgent [53],IBISAgent [18],Ophiuchus [19],MedSAM-Agent [28],XFlow [7],以及nninteractive Agent [16,17] 迭代向无国籍的外部分化器发射点,书写,或箱提示,或像LLMSeg [11]中那样调整参数轮廓.
同时,级联后处理器[6,40,3,9],分区质量估计器[46,37,33,5,35],以及适应性的视觉放大政策[1,52,48],培训单独的网络进行错误估计或作物编辑.
NationalSeg不是在没有完整的切片 VLM 上下文或接受检查的情况下将象征性的提示交给外部的作物工具,而是执行错误本地化(<err>),全局化到本地视觉注意,并在 VLM 内部进行闭环接受验证。

All modules build natively on the Qwen3.8-27B language backbone equipped with rank 16 16 LoRA adapters [ 12 ] ( α LoRA = 32 \alpha_{\text{LoRA}}=32 ) on the top 16 16 layers (Layers 49 49 to 64 64 ), keeping the vision tower and lower 48 48 layers frozen.
Across rounds, the backbone processes up to five native token groups ( Fig. 2 (a), Stage 3): the text Prompt q q , full slice Global visual tokens, zoomed Local visual tokens, a learnable presence token <pres> , and a learnable error token <err> .
Placeholder tokens traverse the frozen lower 48 48 layers, and learnable task embeddings plus a 2D spatial query offset table o sp ∈ ℝ 256 × D o_{\text{sp}}\in\mathbb{R}^{256\times D} (with distinct global/zoom type embeddings) enter the residual stream at Layer 49 49 , avoiding backward passes through Layers 1 1 to 48 48 .

Evaluating multi dataset 3D foundation models on TotalSegmentator risks train on test overlap: documented pretraining lists of 3D SAT [ 51 ] , BiomedParseV2 [ 49 , 50 ] , 3D VoxTell [ 34 ] , and TotalSegmentator [ 41 ] overlap our adult test split ( 53 / 65 = 81.5 % 53/65=81.5\% of test patients appear in SAT’s training list, and VoxTell trained on TotalSegmentator).
We therefore adopt a two part benchmark design:
(i) On TotalSegmentator ( Tab. 1 ), we compare NativeSeg against non native and single pass readout paradigms adapted to the identical Qwen3.8-27B backbone and top 16 16 layer LoRA configuration ( LISA † [ 23 ] , DenseMLLM † [ 25 ] , and F-LMM † [ 43 ] ), as well as fully supervised 2D nnU-Net [ 15 ] and external refiners ( LRN † , a perturbation trained TotalSegmentator reimplementation following [ 3 ] , and box prompted MedSAM2 [ 32 ] ).

Because prior VLM segmenters differ simultaneously in vision language backbones, pretraining corpora, and external mask heads, we evaluate representative readout designs on the identical Qwen3.8-27B backbone, LoRA rank, and adult training split.
Even in a single pass before any zooming, NativeSeg Round 0 0 ( 86.01 % 86.01\% DSC) substantially outperforms non native 1D [SEG] broadcasting ( LISA † , 80.25 % 80.25\% ), pure LLM spatial token decoding ( DenseMLLM † , 82.22 % 82.22\% ), and single slice skip fusion ( F-LMM † , 84.83 % 84.83\% ), confirming that keeping the 2D spatial token grid native to the VLM and coupling it with five slice CT context avoids 1D bottleneck compression.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced NativeSeg , demonstrating that dense 3D CT mask readout, empty slice screening, spatial error diagnosis, and closed loop local refinement can be performed natively over a vision language model’s 2D spatial visual tokens without external SAM decoders, discrete mask codebooks, or stateless box prompting tools.
By uniting five slice spatial token decoding and presence gating ( <pres> ) with multiscale error gated local zoom ( <err> ), closed loop verification, and 3D axial continuity on LoRA adapted Qwen3.8-27B, NativeSeg substantially outperforms non native VLM readouts in domain and zero shot on pediatric CT while safely refining 2D and 3D specialists.

通过将5个片状空间符号解码和存在gating(<pres>)与多级误差门局部缩放(<err>),闭环校验,以及LORA上3D轴连续性(Qune3.8-27B)的组合起来,土著Seg在域内大大超过非本地VLM读取,在安全精炼2D和3D专家的同时,在儿科CT上零镜头.

blocks.zh: 附录A 范围和业务考虑

blocks.en:
Our evaluation trains on 1,081 1{,}081 official adult CT volumes (excluding corrupt scan s0864 ) and evaluates on 65 65 test and 57 57 validation volumes from TotalSegmentator [ 41 ] plus 21 21 external pediatric CT volumes from Pediatric-CT-SEG [ 20 , 21 ] ( 1,224 1{,}224 volumes total) across seven abdominal organs (spleen, right/left kidney, gallbladder, liver, stomach, and pancreas), matching recent volumetric benchmarks [ 10 , 51 , 34 ] .
Although all native modules of NativeSeg (2D spatial token readout, 20 cell error gating, local zoom, and verification) are shared across organs without organ specific heads, extending evaluation to thoracic, vascular, musculoskeletal, and lesion targets is an important future direction.
